map.标准散光放射线表（又称“太阳表/钟表盘”）由中心向外发射等角度射线组成。规则散光: A standard astigmatism radial chart (also called "sunburst / clock dial") has equally angled lines radiating from the center. Regular astigmatism patients perceive some directions as blurrier or fainter, even disappearing, because corneal curvature differs by direction. Wear your daily correction, test one eye at a time at ~30-40cm under good light, and mark the blurry sectors.

map.。它给出的“轴位/严重度”是依据你主观清晰度判断的粗略估算，误差较大，且无法区分: . Its "axis/severity" is a rough estimate from your subjective clarity, with large error, and cannot distinguish regular astigmatism, irregular astigmatism or keratoconus. If you suspect astigmatism, vision loss, eye strain or night glare, or the two eyes differ, see an ophthalmologist for subjective refraction, corneal topography and fundus exam. Minors and those with unstable refraction should be rechecked regularly.
